At affected tag 3000.10.1 (60176b6078ed32aa664329c50aa5a42604dc3f96), GetNewHandler in service/internal/api/api.go registers apiv1connect.NewOliveTinApiServiceHandler with no auth interceptor; service/internal/httpservers/frontend.go mounts that handler at /api/ and rewrites POST /api/olivetin.api.v1.OliveTinApiService/PasswordHash onto the Connect procedure.

oliveTinAPI.PasswordHash at 3000.10.1:143 calls createHash(req.Msg.Password) with no authentication, rate limit, or concurrency guard. createHash/CreateHash in service/internal/api/local_user_login.go calls argon2id.CreateHash with Memory 64*1024 (64 MiB per request). That is a complete unauthenticated source-to-sink for CWE-770.
